question: Should maintainers require redacted live Zalo Personal delivery proof before merging this sanitizer hook, or explicitly override that proof gate based on the sibling-channel pattern and focused tests?
rationale: The code path is narrow and matches accepted sibling fixes, but the contributor explicitly lacks live Zalo Personal access and the hook can suppress user-visible outbound text.

options.title: Require Zalo Personal Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Zalo Personal output, transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing trace text stripped and normal text still delivered before merge.

options.title: Override Based On Siblings
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally accept the message-delivery risk using the small diff, focused tests, and merged sibling-channel precedent as sufficient evidence.

options.title: Pause For Shared Default
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want the umbrella issue solved by a shared outbound sanitizer default instead of per-channel hooks.

recommendation.title: Require Zalo Personal Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Zalo Personal output, transcript, screenshot, recording, terminal output, or logs showing trace text stripped and normal text still delivered before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Zalo Personal adapter blame and shared outbound sanitizer boundary make this the strongest available routing candidate for a proof-gate override or rollout-shape decision.
